Anya: just merged PR #4827 (embedding-indexer: fix chunking). main CI flipped red right after merge.
CI-bot: CI alert on main: job=smoke-integration/embedding-indexer node=node-5 exit=1
CI-bot: failing test: test_embedding_serialization_integration
CI-bot: ```
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File 'tests/integration/test_serialization.py', line 92, in test_embedding_serialization_integration
    obj = MyProto()
    obj.ParseFromString(data)
google.protobuf.message.DecodeError: Error parsing message
```
Oliver: @Anya can you paste the commit sha and which files changed? proto mismatch is my first suspicion.
Anya: sha=3f7b9c2. my PR only touched chunking/indexing code, no .proto or schema files in the diff. attaching my diff.
Tasha: can someone try a quick rerun first? could be a transient infra glitch.
Matt: agreed, rerun first. if it reproduces we should bisect across the last ~6 commits. embedding tests have been flaky recently.
Anya: kicked off rerun: `./scripts/ci/retry_job.sh --job smoke-integration/embedding-indexer --node node-5` :rocket:
CI-bot: rerun started: https://ci.redwood/runs/524321/retry/1
CI-bot: rerun result: FAILED — same decode error, same failing test.
Oliver: consistent failure. @Matt can you start a git bisect? I can help run the failing test locally against candidates.
Matt: starting bisect: `git bisect start --bad 3f7b9c2 --good 3f7b9c2~6` then running `pytest tests/integration/test_serialization.py::test_embedding_serialization_integration -q` locally.
CI-bot: heads-up: vendor/proto-lockfile changed 3 commits ago (possible protobuf client bump).
Tasha: that matches timing. maybe a dependency bump slipped in during a batch update.
Anya: i see vendor/proto-lockfile@9a4e1d5 in the commit chain now. didn't realize it rolled in. i'll try pinning protobuf in my branch and open a revert if bisect points there.
Oliver: if bisect points to the vendor bump, revert that change on main and add a compatibility shim or test for older serialized payloads.
Matt: bisect result: first bad commit = 9a4e1d5 — vendor/proto-lockfile updated protobuf to 4.23.0.
Anya: ok thanks. i'll open a revert PR for the vendor bump and include a small test that decodes golden serialized blobs.
Deploy-checker: urgent-merge gating enabled for reverts. ensure CI is green on the revert branch before merging.
Tasha: and let's add a quick unit or integration test to catch protobuf deserialization regressions in CI.
Anya: PR opened: https://git.redwood/reverts/528 — tagging infra/owners for fast-track. will update once revert is merged and CI reruns. thanks all :heart:
